title: OL-20261112-94: ASK-1: the owner dashboard asks before it acts, like the front door
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** next executor pass
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::us-ask
**Status:** closed

Owner, 2026-11-12 (Session: session_0156nqDuUz7hvNg4YU9MVeAS): the prompted questioning on the front door is the differentiator. Agents answer every prompt and assume; this system asks, because there are unknowns it should not pretend to know. It must feel like it is trying to understand the person, intelligent and not dumbed down, and never overbearing. The owner dashboard and cockpit (dashboard/worker.js, foundation/cockpit.py) have no ask bar and no questions today. Change: give the dashboard the same thread as the front door (site/interview.js askBar): the owner states a direction in the pill input or by voice; the system replies with at most three tap-to-answer either/or questions only where the answer changes what it would do, shows what it understood, then shows each step as it runs. A question the record can already answer is not asked. Record each question, its answer and whether it changed the plan, so the question bank is scored and pruned (links INTERVIEW-2 and INTERVIEW-4). Closing probe: the dashboard renders the ask bar (class us-ask) and its test covers a direction that triggers a question and one that does not.

**Evidence:** dashboard/askbar.js (ASK-1) with POST /api/owner/ask and the us-ask pill form in dashboard/worker.js; dashboard/test/askbar.test.mjs, 8 tests pass.
